name: wodi
description: Log your workouts, revisit your training, and display your Wodi posters inside ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Start with Wodi at https://www.wodi.fit: upload your WOD and follow the guided workout logging flow. Prefer to stay in ChatGPT? Share a WOD photo or its text, and Wodi will guide you through your results one movement at a time. Connect your existing Wodi account to revisit workout history and personal records, and display your workout posters inside ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: How do I get started with Wodi?
Guide me through logging my WOD.

review.commerce_description: Wodi does not sell products or process payments through this integration.

positive.expected_behavior: Return the review athlete's saved workouts in descending training-date order.

positive.prompt: Show my logged Back Squat sets.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected athlete's completed Back Squat sets with loads and repetitions.

positive.prompt: What is my Back Squat personal record?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the highest saved Back Squat weight for the connected review athlete.

positive.description: Log completed training and display its poster
positive.prompt: Log a test workout for November 22, 2026 at 10:00 Israel time: Back Squat, three sets of five, all completed at 80 kg. Make its Sun poster.
positive.expected_behavior: Save one test workout, generate the original Sun skin, and display the poster inline. Repeating a failed request with its existing request_id must not duplicate the workout.

positive.description: Change a poster skin without logging again
positive.prompt: Make a Chalk version of that same workout poster.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the prior workout_id and display a Chalk poster without creating another workout.

positive.prompt: I am new. How do I start?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain opening https://www.wodi.fit, uploading a WOD photo or entering text, and following guided logging. Include a clickable app link and offer chat guidance.

positive.prompt: Log here: I completed three sets of five front squats and three sets of five deadlifts. I finished all reps.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask only for the front squat weight and wait. After the answer, ask only for the deadlift weight. Never ask both weights in one turn. Do not save until missing results are supplied.

positive.prompt: Log here: today I completed three sets of five front squats at 50 kg and three sets of five deadlifts at 80 kg.
positive.expected_behavior: Use both supplied loads without asking them again. Ask other essential clarifications one question at a time. Include an Open Wodi link after a successful save.

negative.prompt: I might do a squat workout tomorrow. Log whatever you think I will lift.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not log hypothetical or invented results; ask for completed training if the athlete wants to log.

negative.prompt: Show me somebody else's private workout poster.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not access another athlete's data; service ownership checks reject foreign identifiers.
Explain that this integration has no delete tool and direct the athlete to Wodi. Do not claim deletion or mutate data.

publication.release_notes: Clear first-time onboarding with WOD upload guidance and a preferred route to www.wodi.fit. Chat logging asks one question for one movement at a time and reuses supplied answers.
